summary.intent: Implement work packages 5 and 6 (client read paths) for the client package, covering broadcast/transport layers, worker-hosted engine communication, and leader election/relay logic.
summary.outcome: An agent implemented WP5+6 across the client package (broadcast, transport, correlated transport, engine client/facade, worker command codec/host/wasm/protocol/serve, and leadership/browser test harnesses), and the changes were committed.

repo: packages/client separates broadcast/transport concerns (broadcast.ts, broadcastTransport.ts, correlatedTransport.ts, transport.ts) from a worker subsystem (worker/commandCodec.ts, worker/engineHost.ts, worker/engineWasm.ts, worker/protocol.ts, worker/serve.ts)
leaderRelay.ts and test/browser/leadership.spec.ts indicate the client implements leader election across browser tabs/workers, backed by a WASM-hosted engine
facade.ts + engineClient.ts form the public client API surface, with testkit.ts providing test doubles
workflow: Work is tracked via numbered 'work packages' (WP5, WP6) delegated to a subagent, then committed as a unit
